analysis_model: claude-code assistant direct visual review (no provider call)
global_invariants: One condensed, heavy sans voice is used for headlines in every sample that carries copy; supporting copy is a much smaller, lighter sans.
Hierarchy is always obvious: one headline or numeral reads first and supporting copy is several times smaller.
Every piece carries the brand mark, small relative to the piece and kept clear of copy, in a corner.
Copy keeps a consistent inner margin and never touches the frame edge.

Accent colour is a small controlled palette per family: red for the editorial and utility families, yellow-green and magenta for culture, violet and magenta for neo-futurist imagery; a piece never uses more accents than its family's palette.
Media is always shown as itself - cropped, isolated or framed - and is never blended into a translucent layer.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A dark portrait photograph bleeds off the left edge and is cropped through the face; the subject looks toward the copy column.
samples.spatial_composition: Two columns: the cropped portrait holds roughly the left two fifths, a stacked headline sits in the dark right column; brand mark bottom-left.
graphic_devices: small red kicker label above the headline
short red slash stroke near the bottom
samples.accent_use: Red used only for the kicker and one stroke; everything else white on black.
samples.visual_tension: Face crop against a tall stacked headline; strong scale contrast between headline and caption.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A black studio object is cropped hard by the right edge on a black ground; a small secondary silhouette sits low.
samples.spatial_composition: One giant red numeral top-left, a medium white headline beneath it, the object filling the right half and leaving the lower-left dark and empty.
graphic_devices: giant accent numeral leading the headline
samples.accent_use: Red for the numeral and one short line; headline stays white.
samples.visual_tension: Numeral scale against a moderate headline, and a heavy object mass against a dark void.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A red-lit night cityscape fills the whole frame with a road vanishing to a point at the bottom; nothing is boxed.
samples.spatial_composition: Headline stacked top-left inside the darkest sky zone, a light subline below it, the vanishing point low and central, brand mark bottom-left.
samples.accent_use: The red is part of the scene lighting, echoed once by nothing else.
samples.visual_tension: Deep perspective against a stacked headline in a quiet zone of the scene.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A single hardware object with a soft glow sits isolated on an almost pure black ground, cropped by nothing.
samples.spatial_composition: The object floats in the upper-middle; a tiny caption stack sits bottom-left; everything else is empty black.
samples.accent_use: No accent colour at all; the glow on the object is the only light.
samples.visual_tension: A small bright object against a very large black void.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A small red smoke-like texture fragment sits in the top-right corner of a black ground and does not touch the copy.
samples.spatial_composition: A red kicker label, a white two-line headline, a giant red numeral and a red subline stack in one left column.
samples.accent_use: Red is used three times in one column; the texture fragment adds a fourth red mass.
samples.visual_tension: White headline above a giant red numeral; the smoke fragment breaks the black.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A dark photo of a surprised face fills the middle of the frame; hand-drawn marks are drawn around and over the head area.
samples.spatial_composition: A wide two-line headline at the top, the face in the middle, a coloured highlight caption low, brand mark bottom-left.
samples.accent_use: Yellow and pink hand-drawn marks and a yellow caption on dark.
samples.visual_tension: A serious face against playful hand-drawn marks.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: Layered torn-paper pieces and a paper backdrop carry scribbles; two round sticker badges sit bottom-left.
samples.spatial_composition: A large dark-red numeral and a condensed headline sit centre on the paper stack; a pink label chip carrying the brand mark bottom-right, an arrow cue at the corner.
graphic_devices: label chip with the brand mark
samples.accent_use: Multi-colour scribbles, one hot pink chip, a dark-red numeral.
samples.visual_tension: Layered rough paper edges and marks against a clean condensed type voice.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A cartoon reaction image is cropped hard into the bottom-right corner of a black ground.
samples.spatial_composition: A neon magenta headline stacked top-left; the reaction image occupies the bottom-right quarter; the bottom-left is empty black; brand mark bottom-left.
samples.accent_use: The headline itself is the accent colour (magenta).
samples.visual_tension: A diagonal between a neon headline (top-left) and a cropped reaction image (bottom-right).

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A dark photograph of an animal forms a horizontal band in the middle of a black ground.
samples.spatial_composition: A short setup line above the band and a short punchline below it: type, image, type stacked in one column; brand mark bottom-left.
graphic_devices: setup line and punchline framing an image band
samples.accent_use: No accent colour; white type only.
samples.visual_tension: The image separates the setup from the punchline.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: Three stacked light rounded option cards read as an interface on a dark ground; neon hand-drawn marks sit in the corners.
samples.spatial_composition: Question top-left, the card stack taking roughly the middle half of the height, a sticker badge bottom-right, brand mark bottom-left.
samples.accent_use: Yellow and pink marks around the cards; the cards stay light.
samples.visual_tension: Bright light cards against a dark, scribbled ground.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A full-frame neon-lit illustrated portrait; the face is in the upper half and the lower half is dark.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: An illustrated portrait fills nearly the whole frame; a red rim light outlines the face.

samples.crop_and_media_relation: A large dark app-icon-like object bleeds off the right edge on a white ground.

families.name: Dark type-and-number statement
families.visual_intent: Type or a single giant numeral is the hero on a solid dark surface; media, if present, is one cropped object or texture fragment that stays secondary to the type.
allowed_media_behaviors: one object cropped hard by the canvas edge
a small texture fragment confined to a corner
spatial_tendencies: numeral stacked above or beside the headline at several times its scale
any media confined to one side, leaving the opposite lower area as dark void
families.negative_space_behavior: Dark empty space is left on the side opposite the copy column and below the text; it is deliberate, not leftover.
families.accent_behavior: One accent colour is spent on the numeral and a small kicker; the headline itself stays white.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: The numeral or the headline itself is the main visual object and its scale is several times the supporting text.
anti_patterns: small text floating in a large empty field
a translucent layer over a photo to make text readable
families.when_not_to_use: Content whose meaning depends on recognising a specific product or scene.

families.name: Hero object stage
families.visual_intent: One recognisable object is the hero, either isolated on a solid ground with generous void or cropped hard by the frame; type is small and stays out of the object's way.
allowed_media_behaviors: an isolated object with a large empty ground around it
an object cropped by two or more frame edges so it fills the piece
an object bleeding off one edge diagonally opposite the text
spatial_tendencies: text top-left with the object bottom-right across an empty diagonal
object high and centred with a tiny caption below
text set in the object's own quiet lower area
graphic_devices: numeral lead-in on the light variant
families.negative_space_behavior: The empty ground around the object is large and intentional; the void is part of the composition.
families.accent_behavior: No accent or a single small one; the object provides the visual interest.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: Recognising the object beats headline size; type is deliberately small next to it.
anti_patterns: the object shrunk to a thumbnail inside a text page
a headline competing with the object for the same area
families.when_not_to_use: Abstract ideas or stories with no single concrete object.

families.name: Immersive image field
families.visual_intent: The image is the scene and owns most of the frame; type sits in a quiet dark zone of the image or beside it, and the mood carries the hook.
allowed_media_behaviors: a full-frame cinematic or illustrated scene bleeding to every edge
a portrait cropped at one edge with the copy in the opposite column
a tiny silhouette for scale inside a deep scene
spatial_tendencies: headline anchored in the darkest zone of the scene, top-left or bottom-left
subject offset to one side and copy on the other
vertical depth with a vanishing point
families.negative_space_behavior: Calm space comes from the dark areas of the scene itself rather than from empty canvas.
families.accent_behavior: Neon or red accents come from the scene's own lighting and are echoed at most once in type.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: The image mood dominates while the type stays very large but subordinate, placed only where the image is quiet.
anti_patterns: a translucent overlay to rescue readability
the image reduced to a small rectangle on a white page
families.when_not_to_use: Content without a strong, dark-toned, quiet-zoned image.

families.name: Internet-culture collage
families.visual_intent: Fast, social-native and humorous: reaction imagery, hand-drawn marks, sticker badges and paper-like fragments with colourful secondary accents, dense but still hierarchical.
allowed_media_behaviors: a reaction image cropped hard into a corner
overlapping paper-like fragments at different scales and small tilts
a photo band framed between a setup line and a punchline
spatial_tendencies: setup above, punchline below, image between
a diagonal between a coloured headline and a cropped image
layered fragments with tight overlaps and no equal grid
families.negative_space_behavior: Minimal: marks and fragments fill the gaps, but one reading order stays obvious.
families.accent_behavior: Several secondary accents at once (yellow-green, magenta), used on marks and one type element.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: Hand-made, deliberately messy marks sit over a controlled condensed type voice.
anti_patterns: random chaos with no reading order

families.name: Interface cards
families.visual_intent: Interaction-led: a question headline over a stack of tappable-looking option cards; the interface itself is the graphic.
allowed_media_behaviors: a stack of light rounded option cards under the question
the card stack fills the middle to lower half of the height
spatial_tendencies: question top-left with cards stacked below at equal gaps
decorative streaks or scribbles only in corners
families.negative_space_behavior: Small: the card stack dominates the frame.
families.accent_behavior: Neon streaks or scribbles in one corner; the cards stay light and neutral.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: Light rounded cards on a dark ground read instantly as UI.
anti_patterns: cards mixed with a large photograph

families.name: Light utility editorial
families.visual_intent: Calm and utility-led on a light ground: a very heavy condensed headline with small, precise supporting copy or a short list, and one red numeral or label as the only accent.
allowed_media_behaviors: one bold isolated object bleeding off one edge
spatial_tendencies: an object on the right bleeding off the frame
a small link cue at the bottom
families.negative_space_behavior: Measured and generous around the list; the space is structured, not an empty canvas.
families.accent_behavior: Red only, used sparingly on one numeral or label.
families.what_makes_it_distinct: A very heavy headline against tiny supporting copy on a light ground.
anti_patterns: small body text floating on a huge white canvas
the same left-aligned layout for every slide

contradictions_kept_distinct: The same giant-numeral device appears on dark solid surfaces (S02, S05, S12) and as a small red lead-in on a light surface (S17): the device is shared, the surface is not.
Density spans from sparse object-on-black (S04, S18) to dense doodle and paper collage (S06, S07, S10) within one board; it is not a single density.
Type is the hero in some samples (S02, S05, S13) and the image is the hero in others (S03, S14, S19).
Light surfaces are a minority mode (S07, S17, S20, plus the mixed S16) beside a dark majority; light must not become the default.
must_not_copy: Any exact wording or copy appearing on the board, including headlines, labels, captions and list items.
The exact imagery, characters, memes, photographs, product renders and artwork shown on the board.
The exact compositions, sample order and crop decisions as a fixed sequence or a pixel replica.
The board's displayed logo artwork, which is not the approved canonical brand mark.
The board as a fixed template or a repeated visual sequence.
originality_constraints: Learn the mechanics of each family; never reproduce a sample.
Create new copy, imagery and arrangements for every publication.
Two pieces from the same family must not share the same geometry.
Treat every conclusion as a hypothesis from one board and verify it in founder review.
